map.镀晶和打蜡有效期差多少？: How much does durability differ between coating and wax?
map.镀晶（无机硅或石英类）与漆面化学键合，通常维持 1–3 年；封体剂（合成聚合物）: Ceramic coatings (inorganic silica or quartz based) bond chemically to the paint and usually last 1–3 years; sealants (synthetic polymer) about 3–6 months; natural carnauba wax about 1–3 months. The difference comes mainly from composition and bonding, and actual life also depends on wash frequency, parking conditions (outdoor sun, tree sap, bird droppings) and climate.
map.剩余天数为负要不要立刻处理？: Days remaining went negative - immediate action needed?
map.超过建议周期只代表保护力下降而非立即损伤，尽快安排护理即可；若漆面已出现水痕、氧: Passing the recommended interval only means protection has weakened, not instant damage; book a treatment soon. If the paint already shows water spots, dull oxidation or a rough feel, polish and correct it first, then coat, so defects are not sealed under the protection layer.
